answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the mandated 18% reduction and the contract ends in 14 days. The low-cost vendor is the only stated option that meets the target on price, and prior memory indicates quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. However, that record does not establish delivery performance at 94% line utilization, so its archived source should be verified before commitment. Incumbent continuity remains the delivery-risk benchmark, while prior negotiation success is not actionable because the incumbent has refused to reopen price.
